services.desc: Discover the beauty of the Florida Keys with a customized leisure cruise in Islamorada. Whether you're looking to snorkel the vibrant coral reefs, relax at the famous Islamorada Sandbar, explore remote backcountry islands, or take in the breathtaking sights of Alligator Reef Lighthouse, our expert captains will craft the perfect day on the water. Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary, home to some of the most stunning coral reefs in North America. Snorkel alongside colorful tropical fish, sea turtles, and vibrant coral formations for an unforgettable underwater experience. Soak up the sun at the iconic Islamorada Sandbar, a must-visit destination
